title: Clocks slow down near the horizon
caption: A clock held at rest at radius r ticks at √(1 − r_s/r) of the rate of a distant clock. At 4r_s it runs at 0.866; at 1.1r_s at 0.3; at the horizon the factor reaches zero: seen from far away, nothing ever crosses it.
alt: Clock rate relative to a distant clock against distance from the black hole in Schwarzschild radii: zero at the horizon, rising steeply and levelling towards 1.
description: Distance in units of the Schwarzschild radius r_s.
Rate = √(1 − r_s/r) for a clock at rest.
Far away the rate tends to 1.
